thread:
rachel_fin: Heads up - Customer NOVA Corp got charged a $12k burst overage on INV-2026-00610 for May. They claim burst happened during onboarding (trial traffic spike) and want it waived.

ben_sales: I talked to the AM this morning. Onboarding event shows lots of test traffic 2026-05-04 -> 05-06. NOVA expected trial to be covered; contract RWI-2026-NV section 3.2 says "initial ramp bursts <= 7 days may be considered for one-time waiver at Redwood discretion".

emily_sre: Confirmed spike timeline. In infra logs: sustained burst 2026-05-04T02:00Z -> 2026-05-06T18:00Z, peak ~3.2x expected throughput. We have request IDs. No system outage, just unexpected load.

tom_billing: Invoice shows reserved commit $30,000 + burst overage $12,000 + tax $2,640 -> total $44,640. Overage computed by billing engine using rate $0.06/overage-unit.

ben_sales: Customer asks for full waiver of $12k. AM suggests we offer either full waiver or 50% waiver + trial extension. Need finance/legal ok.

legal-bot: Flagging contract clause 3.2 and the onboarding waiver clause 9.1. Legal: waiver is discretionary but must be documented; if we grant, record as one-time credit and update contract addendum.

rachel_fin: Financial considerations: one-time waiver of $12k reduces May recognized revenue; accounting prefers credit applied to next invoice rather than cash refund. Also need GL reversal code and memo.

emily_sre: Also note NOVA filed an SLA ticket for latency during that period; SLO breach minimal (4% exceedance over month). Per SLA table that's <10% -> no SLA credit per contract. So SLA credit doesn't apply.

ben_sales: OK so SLA credit not applicable. Decision points: 1) Do we grant full waiver? 2) If yes, do we apply as invoice credit or cash refund? 3) Any follow-up (trial extension / doc update)?

tom_billing: Proposal: offer 50% waiver ($6k) + 30-day trial extension. Rationale: keeps revenue, keeps customer happy, aligns with precedent (see AR-2987 last quarter). If AM pushes, escalate to CFO.

rachel_fin: I support 50% waiver as credit on next invoice. GL codes: 4305 reversal for $6k; use memo "Onboarding burst credit - NOVA RWI-2026-NV". Create AR ticket.

billing-bot: Created AR ticket AR-3399 and billing task TASK-8567. Assigned to tom_billing.

ben_sales: I'll get customer sign-off on the 50% + 30d extension and send note with the infra logs attached. Will include option to request cash refund which will need CFO approval.

legal-bot: If customer requests cash refund, route to Legal+Finance for approval and create contract addendum.

emily_sre: Adding incident/trace refs INC-2026-201 and trace IDs to AR ticket.

rachel_fin: Once billing posts credit, finance will adjust recognition for May. Tom, please attach the calculation: overage units, rate, and credit amount.

tom_billing: Will do today. Will also include the waived unit count (200k units -> $12,000; waive 100k = $6,000).

ben_sales: Thanks team. I'll update NOVA and reply here after they accept.
